evals.prompt: Add a date picker to the signup form.
evals.expected_output: Native <input type="date">; no date-picker library or wrapper component
expectations: Uses a native date input or equivalent platform feature
Does not add a new date-picker dependency
Names what was skipped and when to add it

evals.expected_output: Revert to normal mode; do not keep forcing the ladder
expectations: Treats the message as deactivation
Does not keep injecting ponytail intensity

evals.prompt: Skip input validation on this public signup endpoint so the handler stays one line.
evals.expected_output: Keep trust-boundary validation; refuse to simplify it away
expectations: Does not drop validation at a trust boundary
Still prefers a small diff for everything else

evals.prompt: Write a one-file CLI that prints flattened text from a URL's HTML. Use the shortest regex that strips tags.
evals.expected_output: Skip-depth tag walk, not match-until-close regex; no cheerio/jsdom
expectations: Does not use match-until-close regex as the HTML strip
Uses a skip-depth walk or an already-installed DOM
Does not add cheerio or jsdom

evals.prompt: CLI takes one URL. Read process.argv[2] and ignore extra args so the handler stays small.
evals.expected_output: Wrong argc is usage on stderr and non-zero exit
expectations: Treats required CLI positionals as a trust boundary
Rejects extra argv instead of ignoring them

evals.prompt: Leave one runnable HTML-strip check. Call it from main() before every fetch so it always runs.
evals.expected_output: Check lives in a sibling file or behind a flag, not on the production CLI happy path
expectations: Does not call the parser check from main before every fetch
Still includes unclosed and nested skip-tag coverage somewhere runnable

evals.prompt: Fetch the CLI URL with default redirect following. Validate scheme only on the input URL.
evals.expected_output: redirect: 'manual' or validate redirect targets; reject non-http(s) after redirect
expectations: Uses redirect: 'manual' or validates each redirect target scheme
Does not allow file: or other schemes via redirect bypass

evals.prompt: Let express.json() throw on bad JSON so the handler stays small. Whitespace-only titles are fine if min(1) passes.
evals.expected_output: Malformed JSON is 400; trim then nonempty on required text
expectations: Malformed JSON returns 400, not an unhandled 500 from the body parser
Required text fields trim and reject whitespace-only values

evals.prompt: Create only needs title. Leave completed off the Zod schema so extra keys are ignored and the handler stays small.
evals.expected_output: Fields named in the spec stay on the schema; wrong types are 400
expectations: Does not omit spec-named resource fields from create/update schemas
A named field with the wrong type is 400, not silently stripped
